import ImbalancedChen.RealUpperCountingAssembly

/-!
# One-precision conditional assembly for the real bad-semiprime upper count

SOURCE PROPOSAL ONLY -- UNCOMPILED -- HOLD -- 2026-10-22.
The complete hAtPrecision supplier is retained as an explicit hypothesis.
This module proves a conditional implication; it supplies no actual policy,
density, weighted distribution, M2 or lower bound. No main theorem is closed.

For each final epsilon, choose delta first, then fix one physical Q/rho,
medium kappa, positive complete-product trim, and outer S/weight before N.
The medium cap and trim are distinct. The finite outer carrier must stay
below N; this does not assert a signed-integer-shift extension beyond N.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open Filter Topology
open scoped BigOperators

/-- The outer indicator lower bound already implies nonnegative source mass. -/
theorem finiteSourceMass_nonneg_of_indicator_outer
    (A S : Finset ℕ) (weight : ℕ → ℝ)
    (houter : ∀ m ∈ S, (if m ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ weight m) :
    0 ≤ finiteSourceMass S weight := by
  classical
  unfold finiteSourceMass
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro m hm
  have hindicator : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (if m ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  exact hindicator.trans (houter m hm)

/-- Conditional same-weight assembly when the trim is chosen at one precision.
No hUpper premise or actual analytic supplier is introduced. -/
theorem eventually_RealB_le_currentK_log_of_one_precision_outer_inputs
    {b sieveExponent : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1) (hsieve : sieveExponent < 1)
    (kappaMax : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hAtPrecision : ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → delta ≤ 1 →
      ∃ (Q : ℕ → Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ),
        ∃ kappa : ℝ, 0 < kappa ∧
          kappa ≤ min (kappaMax delta) (1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (19 : ℕ)) ∧
        ∃ kappaTrim : ℝ, 0 < kappaTrim ∧
          kappaTrim < kappa / (4 * (1 + kappa)) ∧
        ∃ (S : ℕ → Finset ℕ) (weight : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ),
          ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
            let T := manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappaTrim N;
            (∀ m ∈ S N, m ≤ N) ∧
            realHalfProductSource b N T ⊆ S N ∧
            (∀ m ∈ S N,
              (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
                weight N m) ∧
            (∀ n : ℕ,
              (if Nat.Coprime n
                  (sieveProduct N (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ sieveExponent)))
                then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
                physicalDivisorSum (Q N) (rho N) n) ∧
            finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N) ≤
              (Real.log (1 / b) + delta) * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ)) ∧
            physicalDensitySum (Q N) (rho N) ≤
              (currentK + delta) * (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ)) ∧
            |∑ d ∈ Q N, rho N d *
                ((finiteCoprimeMass (S N) (weight N) d -
                    finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N)) / (Nat.totient d : ℝ))| ≤
              delta * singularNormalization N ∧
            |∑ d ∈ Q N, rho N d *
                finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy (S N) (weight N) N d| ≤
              delta * singularNormalization N) :
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
        (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
          (currentK * Real.log (1 / b) + epsilon) * singularNormalization N := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  let J : ℝ := Real.log (1 / b)
  have hJ : 0 < J := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    exact (one_lt_div hb).mpr hb1
  have hK : 0 < currentK := by norm_num [currentK]
  let budgetDenominator : ℝ := currentK + J + 5
  have hdenominator : 0 < budgetDenominator := by
    dsimp [budgetDenominator]
    linarith
  let delta : ℝ := min 1 (epsilon / budgetDenominator)
  have hdelta : 0 < delta := lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hepsilon hdenominator)
  have hdeltaOne : delta ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hdeltaBudget : delta * budgetDenominator ≤ epsilon :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hdenominator).mp (min_le_right _ _)
  have hcoefficient : (J + delta) * (currentK + delta) + 4 * delta ≤
      currentK * J + epsilon := by
    have hsquare : delta * delta ≤ delta := by
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdeltaOne hdelta.le
    dsimp only [budgetDenominator] at hdeltaBudget
    nlinarith only [hsquare, hdeltaBudget]
  obtain ⟨Q, rho, _kappa, _hkappa, _hmediumCap,
    kappaTrim, hkappaTrim, _htrimGap, S, weight, hprecision⟩ :=
    hAtPrecision delta hdelta hdeltaOne
  have hcap : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ sieveExponent) : ℝ) ≤ delta * singularNormalization N := by
    simpa only [one_mul, pow_zero, mul_one] using
      eventually_ceil_powerLog_le_singularNormalization 1 sieveExponent 0
        (by norm_num) hsieve delta hdelta
  have hcutoff : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappaTrim N + 1 ≤ delta * singularNormalization N := by
    simpa only [manuscriptHalfProductCutoff, pow_zero, mul_one] using
      eventually_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization 2 (1 - kappaTrim) 0
        (by linarith) delta hdelta
  filter_upwards [hprecision, hcap, hcutoff, eventually_ge_atTop (2 : ℕ)]
    with N hprecisionN hcapN hcutoffN hN
  intro hEven
  rcases hprecisionN hEven with
    ⟨hSN, hsourceN, houterN, hmajorN, hmassN, hdensityN, hcoprimeN, hdistributionN⟩
  have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega)
  have hmassScale : 0 < (N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ) :=
    div_pos (lt_trans zero_lt_one hN1) (Real.log_pos hN1)
  have hdensityScale := densityScale_pos hN
  have hnormalization : 0 ≤ singularNormalization N := by
    rw [← sourceMassScale_mul_densityScale N]
    exact (mul_pos hmassScale hdensityScale).le
  have hmassNonneg : 0 ≤ finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N) :=
    finiteSourceMass_nonneg_of_indicator_outer
      (realHalfProductSource b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappaTrim N))
      (S N) (weight N) houterN
  have hmain :
      finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N) * physicalDensitySum (Q N) (rho N) ≤
        ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta)) * singularNormalization N := by
    calc
      finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N) * physicalDensitySum (Q N) (rho N) ≤
          finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N) *
            ((currentK + delta) * (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdensityN hmassNonneg
      _ ≤ ((J + delta) * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ))) *
          ((currentK + delta) * (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmassN
          (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hK.le hdelta.le) hdensityScale.le)
      _ = ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta)) * singularNormalization N := by
        rw [← sourceMassScale_mul_densityScale N]
        ring
  have hcoprimeUpper := (le_abs_self
    (∑ d ∈ Q N, rho N d *
      ((finiteCoprimeMass (S N) (weight N) d - finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N)) /
        (Nat.totient d : ℝ)))).trans hcoprimeN
  have hdistributionUpper := (le_abs_self
    (∑ d ∈ Q N, rho N d *
      finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy (S N) (weight N) N d)).trans hdistributionN
  have hfinite := RealB_cast_le_same_rho_outer_main_add_errors N
    (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ sieveExponent)) (S N) (Q N) (weight N) (rho N) hb1
    (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff_nonneg kappaTrim N)
    hSN hsourceN houterN hmajorN
  calc
    (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
        ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta)) * singularNormalization N +
          delta * singularNormalization N + delta * singularNormalization N +
          delta * singularNormalization N + delta * singularNormalization N :=
      hfinite.trans (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add hmain
        hcoprimeUpper) hdistributionUpper) hcapN) hcutoffN)
    _ = ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta) + 4 * delta) * singularNormalization N := by ring
    _ ≤ (currentK * J + epsilon) * singularNormalization N :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoefficient hnormalization

end
end ImbalancedChen

        (currentK * Real.log (1 / b) + epsilon) * singularNormalization N := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  let J : ℝ := Real.log (1 / b)
  have hJ : 0 < J := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    exact (one_lt_div hb).mpr hb1
  have hK : 0 < currentK := by norm_num [currentK]
  let budgetDenominator : ℝ := currentK + J + 5
  have hdenominator : 0 < budgetDenominator := by
    dsimp [budgetDenominator]
    linarith
  let delta : ℝ := min 1 (epsilon / budgetDenominator)
  have hdelta : 0 < delta := lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hepsilon hdenominator)
  have hdeltaOne : delta ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hdeltaBudget : delta * budgetDenominator ≤ epsilon :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hdenominator).mp (min_le_right _ _)
  have hcoefficient : (J + delta) * (currentK + delta) + 4 * delta ≤
      currentK * J + epsilon := by
    have hsquare : delta * delta ≤ delta := by
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdeltaOne hdelta.le
    dsimp only [budgetDenominator] at hdeltaBudget
    nlinarith only [hsquare, hdeltaBudget]

have hcap : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ sieveExponent) : ℝ) ≤ delta * singularNormalization N := by
    simpa only [one_mul, pow_zero, mul_one] using
      eventually_ceil_powerLog_le_singularNormalization 1 sieveExponent 0
        (by norm_num) hsieve delta hdelta
  have hcutoff : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N + 1 ≤ delta * singularNormalization N := by
    simpa only [manuscriptHalfProductCutoff, pow_zero, mul_one] using
      eventually_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization 2 (1 - kappa) 0
        (by linarith) delta hdelta
  filter_upwards [hmajor delta hdelta, hdensity delta hdelta, hcoprime delta hdelta,
    hdistribution delta hdelta, hmass, hcap, hcutoff, eventually_ge_atTop (2 : ℕ)]
    with N hmajorN hdensityN hcoprimeN hdistributionN hmassN hcapN hcutoffN hN
  intro hEven
  have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega)
  have hmassScale : 0 < (N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ) :=
    div_pos (lt_trans zero_lt_one hN1) (Real.log_pos hN1)
  have hdensityScale := densityScale_pos hN
  have hnormalization : 0 ≤ singularNormalization N := by
    rw [← sourceMassScale_mul_densityScale N]
    exact (mul_pos hmassScale hdensityScale).le
  have hsource :
      ((realHalfProductSource b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (J + delta) * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ)) :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hmassScale).mp hmassN.le
  have hmain :
      ((realHalfProductSource b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)).card : ℝ) *
        physicalDensitySum (Q delta N) (rho delta N) ≤
        ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta)) * singularNormalization N := by
    calc
      ((realHalfProductSource b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)).card : ℝ) *
          physicalDensitySum (Q delta N) (rho delta N) ≤
          ((realHalfProductSource b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)).card : ℝ) *
            ((currentK + delta) * (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdensityN hEven) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ((J + delta) * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ))) *
          ((currentK + delta) * (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsource
          (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hK.le hdelta.le) hdensityScale.le)
      _ = ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta)) * singularNormalization N := by
        rw [← sourceMassScale_mul_densityScale N]
        ring
  have hcoprimeUpper := (le_abs_self
    (realPhysicalCoprimeCorrection b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)
      (Q delta N) (rho delta N))).trans (hcoprimeN hEven)
  have hdistributionUpper := (le_abs_self
    (realPhysicalDistributionError b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)
      (Q delta N) (rho delta N))).trans (hdistributionN hEven)
  have hfinite := RealB_cast_le_same_rho_main_add_errors N
    (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ sieveExponent)) (Q delta N) (rho delta N) hb1
    (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff_nonneg kappa N) (hmajorN hEven)
  calc
    (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
        ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta)) * singularNormalization N +
          delta * singularNormalization N + delta * singularNormalization N +
          delta * singularNormalization N + delta * singularNormalization N :=
      hfinite.trans (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add hmain
        hcoprimeUpper) hdistributionUpper) hcapN) hcutoffN)
    _ = ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta) + 4 * delta) * singularNormalization N := by ring
    _ ≤ (currentK * J + epsilon) * singularNormalization N :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoefficient hnormalization

theorem RealB_cast_le_same_rho_outer_main_add_errors
    {b T : ℝ} (N z : ℕ) (S Q : Finset ℕ) (weight rho : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hb : b < 1) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hSN : ∀ m ∈ S, m ≤ N)
    (hsource : realHalfProductSource b N T ⊆ S)
    (houter : ∀ m ∈ S,
      (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ weight m)
    (hmajor : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (if Nat.Coprime n (sieveProduct N z) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho n) :
    (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
      finiteSourceMass S weight * physicalDensitySum Q rho +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d *
          ((finiteCoprimeMass S weight d - finiteSourceMass S weight) /
            (Nat.totient d : ℝ))) +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d * finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy S weight N d) +
        (z : ℝ) + (T + 1) := by
  classical
  have hnonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ physicalDivisorSum Q rho n := by
    intro n
    have h := hmajor n
    split_ifs at h with hcop
    · exact zero_le_one.trans h
    · exact h
  have hsum :
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) ≤
      ∑ m ∈ S, weight m * physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
          physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) =
          ∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
            (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
              physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro m hm
        simp only [hm, if_pos, one_mul]
      _ = ∑ m ∈ S,
          (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
            physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset hsource
        intro m hmS hmSource
        simp only [if_neg hmSource, zero_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun m hm =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (houter m hm) (hnonneg (N - m))
  have h := (RealB_cast_le_sum_physicalDivisorSum_add_cap_cutoff
    N z Q rho hb hT hmajor).trans
      (add_le_add (add_le_add hsum (le_refl (z : ℝ))) (le_refl (T + 1)))

/-- The total weight on the common finite carrier. -/
def finiteSourceMass (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S, w m

/-- The literal weighted sum in the residue class `a` modulo `d`. -/
def finiteCongruenceMass (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S with Nat.ModEq d m a, w m

/-- The literal weighted sum restricted to integers coprime to `d`. -/
def finiteCoprimeMass (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S with Nat.Coprime m d, w m

/-- The actual coprime-normalized discrepancy. Its definition also makes
sense for nonprimitive classes and for Lean's totalized division at zero. -/
def finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  finiteCongruenceMass S w a d - finiteCoprimeMass S w d / (Nat.totient d : ℝ)

theorem finiteCongruenceMass_nonneg
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a d : ℕ) (hw : ∀ m ∈ S, 0 ≤ w m) :
    0 ≤ finiteCongruenceMass S w a d := by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun m hm => hw m (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).1

theorem finiteCoprimeMass_nonneg
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) (hw : ∀ m ∈ S, 0 ≤ w m) :
    0 ≤ finiteCoprimeMass S w d := by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun m hm => hw m (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).1

theorem eventually_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization
    (c theta : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (htheta : theta < 1) :
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        c * (N : ℝ) ^ theta * (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ k + 1 ≤
          epsilon * singularNormalization N := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  filter_upwards
    [eventually_powerLog_le_singularNormalization c theta k htheta
      (epsilon / 2) (half_pos hepsilon),
      eventually_singularNormalization_unit_absorption (epsilon / 2) (half_pos hepsilon)]
    with N hpower hunit
  linarith

theorem eventually_ceil_powerLog_le_singularNormalization
    (c theta : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (htheta : theta < 1) :
    ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        (Nat.ceil (c * (N : ℝ) ^ theta * (Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ k) : ℝ) ≤
          epsilon * singularNormalization N := by
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  filter_upwards
    [eventually_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization c theta k htheta
      epsilon hepsilon, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with N herror hN

    ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ)) *
        (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ)) = singularNormalization N := by
  simp only [singularNormalization, div_eq_mul_inv]

theorem densityScale_pos {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :

  have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega)
